meridian-pms.buildCommand:
set -e
echo "=== Build starting ==="
echo "Node: $(node -v) | npm: $(npm -v)"

# ── Step 1: Apply database migrations ──
# Use DIRECT_DATABASE_URL if set (session mode), otherwise auto-derive from pooler URL
if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then
  MIGRATE_URL="${DIRECT_DATABASE_URL:-$DATABASE_URL}"

  # If no DIRECT_DATABASE_URL and pooler detected, auto-switch port 5432 → 6543 (session mode)
  if [ -z "$DIRECT_DATABASE_URL" ] && echo "$MIGRATE_URL" | grep -q 'pooler\.supabase\.com:5432'; then
    MIGRATE_URL=$(echo "$MIGRATE_URL" | sed 's|pooler\.supabase\.com:5432|pooler.supabase.com:6543|' | sed 's|[?&]pgbouncer=true||g' | sed 's|&|?|1' | sed 's|?$||')
    echo "[migrate] Detected Supabase PgBouncer — auto-switched to session-mode port 6543"
  fi

  # Also set SSL cert for migrations (write embedded cert to /tmp)
  echo "[migrate] Running prisma migrate deploy..."
  DATABASE_URL="$MIGRATE_URL" npx prisma migrate deploy 2>&1 || {
    echo "[warn] prisma migrate deploy failed — attempting fallback with db push"
    DATABASE_URL="$MIGRATE_URL" npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss 2>&1 || {
      echo "[warn] prisma db push also failed (non-fatal, POST /api/db-setup can sync at runtime)"
    }
  }
else
  echo "[migrate] DATABASE_URL not set — skipping migrations"
fi

# ── Step 2: Generate Prisma client ──
echo "[prisma] Generating client..."
npx prisma generate

# ── Step 3: Next.js build ──
echo "[next] Building..."
npx next build

echo "=== Build complete ==="
